Theme

playground noun

modern

Traupman 53, 361

ārea lūsōria; āreae lūsōriae f.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) lūsōrium, lūsōriī n. — playground (our short word)

    noun, second declension · also used · * our formation

    Our family’s own word (the Libellus VII gloss: ārea lūsōria (ārea lūsōria: Traupman 53; lūsōrium: locūtiō nostra)), short for everyday use with the child.

  • campus lūsōrius

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. playground

  • locus lūsōrius parvulōrum — playground for little children

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. playground

Examples

  • Eāmus ad āream lūsōriam.

    Let’s go to the playground.composed

  • Eāmus ad lūsōrium, Baba, curriculō!

    Let’s run to the playground, Baba!Libellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

  • lūsōrium autem, quod ante lūdum est, oscillīs et scālīs et tabulā dēclīvī īnstrūctum, semper patet

    but the playground in front of the school, with its swings, ladders and slide, is always openLibellus VII, Diēs ūnus Osoitsae

See also slide, swing, seesaw, climbing frame, sandpit, bench.
